ThingDef.label: replicator-stripped wall rib
ThingDef.description: A structural rib left after Replicators disassembled nearly all useful matter from a wall. Parallel block-sized bite marks run along the remaining spine. It is inert aftermath scenery and contains no recoverable Replicator mass.

ThingDef.label: replicator-scoured machine husk
ThingDef.description: An empty machinery frame whose motors, wiring, bearings and dense structural members were removed with unnervingly regular precision. Only low-value shell material remains. It is inert aftermath scenery and contains no recoverable Replicator mass.

ThingDef.label: replicator consumption scar
ThingDef.description: A low field of fused fragments and standardized block impressions where a swarm reduced larger machinery to feedstock. The pattern records motion and consumption rather than deliberate construction. It is inert aftermath scenery and contains no recoverable Replicator mass.
